title: Persona 5 Strikers
summary: Cutscene runs with sound and no picture. Its video is VC-1 with WMA Pro audio, which the fix decodes itself where the engine cannot. Runs on DXMT only.

credits.name: winevideo
credits.note: Independent confirmation of the shared-texture cutscene path, which winevideo repairs inside a patched Wine d3d9.dll.

excerpts.note: Wine's d3d9 answers a shared render target with S_OK and a null handle; where it leaves that hole, the bridge hands the game a real shared handle.

cause: No CrossOver ships a VC-1 decoder, and with one staged the reader still never reads a sample, because the shared D3D9 render target it is given has a null handle.
